original_test_intent: Verify that the Location enum in every SMBIOS Type 16 Physical Memory Array record identifies the approved physical array placement, is associated with the correct Type 17 devices and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete Type 16 and Type 17 records, identify each array by handle and companion fields, resolve every Type 17 Physical Memory Array Handle, compare the resulting location-to-device map with the approved platform topology, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the platform topology and reboot plan. Physical DIMM handling is neither required nor authorized for this record check.
required_inputs: Expected Type 16 Location enum per array handle or stable array identity
Platform physical memory-array and DIMM-slot topology
Type 16-to-Type 17 handle/link policy including empty slots
Policy for Unknown, Other and vendor-specific enum values
Validated dmidecode access plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and OS inventory queries; do not install, remove or reseat DIMMs.
Do not change memory configuration, inject errors, clear logs or modify firmware.
Resolve location only within the correct Type 16 record and retain its handle, use, capacity and ECC context.
Treat dangling, duplicate or unresolved Type 17 array handles as explicit evidence gaps, not as an inferred location.
Stop on topology ambiguity or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse all Type 16 array handles and locations, resolve Type 17 links, compare the approved topology and pre/post reboot state, and collect read-only OS context.
Do not touch memory hardware, reinterpret undocumented enums or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the per-array location/topology and special-enum/link policies.
Approve reboot/recovery and determine the formal verdict from the resolved topology evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The decoded location is relevant, but grep -A1 loses the Type 16 handle and companion fields and cannot associate Type 17 devices with that array.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 16 and Type 17 output; report each array handle/location/use/capacity/ECC and every linked Type 17 handle, locator and presence state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Location scope, linked Type 16 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing is excluded as destructive and irrelevant to read-only topology metadata.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-handle Type 16 location map, resolve all Type 17 Physical Memory Array Handle references, correlate the approved physical slot topology and repeat the same complete inventory after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems exposing SMBIOS Type 16 Physical Memory Array and Type 17 Memory Device records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode and OS inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 16 Location enum and Type 17 Physical Memory Array Handle semantics, plus authoritative platform memory topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds record identity, cross-record handle resolution and complete physical-topology comparison to the isolated location string.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects correct-looking locations attached to the wrong array, dangling device links, duplicate handles and cross-array topology drift.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-array location baseline and platform memory map.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS NUMA information may corroborate populated topology but does not define the firmware Location enum or represent empty slots.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a platform-specific number of arrays and location enum for each, but must version the Type 16 handles or stable identities together with the Type 17 slot map; an OS-only topology cannot silently replace the SMBIOS requirement.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity, per-array Location enum, Type 16/17 mapping and physical memory topology
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16 and Type 17 records with handles and companion fields
Resolved array-to-device/slot map including empty and unresolved references
Read-only OS memory/NUMA context labeled as corroborating evidence
Approved reboot/health evidence and complete post-reboot topology diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Location item, generic information procedure and correctness/persistence criteria are compatible; the missing platform map is an execution input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Location and handle topology are deterministically collectable after approved inputs; no irreducible ambiguity or manual core acceptance exists.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds array identity, companion fields, Type 17 link resolution and topology-level validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains complete topology and safety controls while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification under locked V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates approved topology inputs and engineer verdict from automated record/link validation.

review_improvement: Prevents a valid enum label from passing when it belongs to the wrong array or its devices reference missing or different Type 16 handles.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 16 Location and Type 17 handle relationships are structured firmware data; their complete graph and reboot stability can be parsed and compared without physical memory action.
